title: Stability of Vortex Patches in Channels
summary: In this paper, we investigate the orbital stability of vortex patches for the two-dimensional incompressible Euler equations in both a class of domains that satisfy the ``weak finite volume condition" and a strip of arbitrary width. We establish that for suitable parameters $(μ,λ)$, the penalized kinetic energy functional admits a minimizer, and that every such minimizer satisfies the elliptic equation $ω= λ(ψ- W x_2 - γ)_+$.
